caption_L1: This is a bar diagram titled Annual number of data breaches and exposed records in the United States from 2005 to 1st half 2020 (in millions). Along the x-axis, Million records exposed is defined. Along the y-axis, Year is measured.
caption_L2L3: 2018 was the year with the most recorded data breaches, at over 450 million records exposed. 2010 saw the least recorded data breaches, with under 25 million. it seems to be a trend that between years with larger numbers of data breaches, for instance in 2009 where there were over 200 million, both before and after there will be significantly fewer instances. you do not see many consecutive years where the number of recorded data breaches continues to be high: there is usually a visible lull. data breaches on the whole have become more frequent from 2005 to 2019.
